text:
jun: hey all 👋 i'm wrapping up onboarding tasks. i can see most docs but hitting 403 when opening the Sentry project and Grafana traces dashboard. which group should i ask for access?

harini: welcome Jun! :tada: Sentry projects are gated by team memberships. pinging @leo from infra — leo, can you add jun to `platform-observability`?

leo: got it. Jun, i'll add you in a min. can you confirm your org email? also FYI our Sentry uses org-level SSO, so sometimes you need to re-login after being added.

jun: jun.lee@redwood.com — thanks. re-login note helpful. i'm also missing a couple Grafana panels: traces + error-heatmap.

leo: for Grafana there's a nested folder permission: Dashboards -> Observability -> Traces is in the `obs-team` folder. i'll add you to the Grafana "viewer" role and the obs-team ACL.

access-bot: Access request received: resource=Grafana:Dashboards/Observability/Traces, requester=jun.lee@redwood.com, status=pending. Use `access status 1840000123` to check.

harini: quick tips: if you need to run local traces, use `otel-local` instructions in the dev docs. for Sentry, if you want to see release-level grouping enable "Release view" in the top-right.

jun: thanks — small snag: when i try to open Datadog APM link from the runbook i get redirected to a non-prod org. is there a canonical APM link?

leo: yeah, we spun a new Datadog org last quarter. use https://app.datadoghq.com/apm/services?env:production&query=service%3Aapi-service — will require Datadog read role. i've queued that with our identity team for you.

jun: appreciated. one more Q: who can create alert monitors? i'd like to add a low-severity alert for high tail latency on my feature env.

harini: monitor creation is restricted to SRE+owners. for feature-env alerts, create a request in the "Monitoring Changes" doc (link in infra handbook) and tag `oncall` — SRE will triage and either create it or give you a runbook to do it yourself.

leo: jun, i added you to Grafana viewer + obs-team, and requested Datadog read. Sentry invite sent to your email — accept and re-login. should be propagated in ~2-5 mins.

jun: i got the Sentry invite, accepted, and can now see the project! the traces dashboard is still 403 though.

leo: hmm, try clearing cookies or an incognito window after accepting SSO invite. also confirm you're in the `obs-team` group on the access page: https://access.redwood.com/groups/obs-team

jun: incognito worked — can see traces and error-heatmap. i can also grab a snapshot for docs. question: what's the preferred way to share a Grafana panel in PRs?

harini: use panel -> share -> Snapshot -> External link. add the link in PR description and add `observability` reviewer if it's dashboard related.

jun: perfect. thanks everyone — this saved me a lot of time. happy to pair with infra to make a short onboarding note for new hires if that's helpful.

leo: yes please, a 2-min checklist (Sentry, Grafana, Datadog links + common roles) would be awesome. drop it in the onboarding doc and ping #devex, we'll link it from the handbook.

jun: will do and send a draft later today :slightly_smiling_face:

access-bot: access changes completed for jun.lee@redwood.com: Grafana:viewer, Group:obs-team, Sentry:member.

jun: confirmed all good now. thanks again! :raised_hands:
